operations.name: Edward J. Kelly

expected.charges: Tried for murder as an alleged member of the Molly Maguires, in prosecutions led by Reading Railroad president Franklin B.
expected.sentence:
Death by hanging at the Carbon County Prison in Mauch Chunk, Pennsylvania, on June 21, 1877.

Verdict as recorded: Yes — convicted of murder and executed by hanging.

Charges as recorded: Tried for murder as an alleged member of the Molly Maguires, in prosecutions led by Reading Railroad president Franklin B. Gowen and built largely on the testimony of the Pinkerton infiltrator James McParland.

operations.research_note: Mathews and Hungerford, History of the Counties of Lehigh and Carbon (1884), printed p.620: September 3, 1875 capture of Edward Kelly, Michael J. Doyle and James Kerrigan, with jail admission at Mauch Chunk that evening. Original Internet Archive OCR independently checked against the transcription. Used only for custody chronology; the book has a strongly hostile editorial viewpoint. Biography and existing endpoint preserved.
